    <p class="body-text" style="margin-top: 1.75rem;">Each project on this page represents a real business question I worked through end to end, from raw data to findings and recommendations I could actually stand behind. My hope is that the work here gives a clear picture of how I think as an analyst and what I could bring to a team. Click any card below to visit its dedicated project page.</p>

    <p class="body-text">Projects span two tracks, <strong>Data Visualization</strong> and <strong>Predictive Analytics</strong>. Each card links to a dedicated page with findings, recommendations, methodology, and key takeaways, with reports, slides, and code attached where applicable.</p>

    <div class="section-label" style="margin-top: 2rem;">Data Visualization</div>

    <div class="proj-card" id="proj-letterboxd">
      <div class="proj-header">
        <p class="proj-title">Letterboxd: Movies as a Business and a Taste</p>
        <p class="proj-meta">Independent Project</p>
        <p class="proj-dates">Planned</p>
      </div>
      <p class="proj-desc">A live, auto-updating window into film as both a personal passion and a commercial product, pairing my own ratings, watchlist, and physical media collection with box office and budget data to explore what they reveal about film as culture and commerce.</p>
      <p class="proj-skills"><strong>Deliverables:</strong> Power BI Dashboards</p>
      <p class="proj-skills"><strong>Technical Skills:</strong> TBD</p>
    </div>

    <a class="proj-card alt" id="proj-hyundai" href="projects/hyundai/index.html">
      <div class="proj-header">
        <p class="proj-title">STP Dashboard</p>
        <p class="proj-meta">Hyundai Capital America (HCA) Internship</p>
        <p class="proj-dates">06/2026-08/2026</p>
      </div>
      <p class="proj-desc">Restructured HCA's manual STP (Speed-to-Proficiency) Tracker around a relational, class-level data model built on Jira-linked primary and foreign keys, then automated the pipeline with Power Query and delivered five interactive Tableau dashboards giving leadership self-service visibility into training performance, cutting monthly reporting effort by 60%.</p>
      <p class="proj-skills"><strong>Deliverables:</strong> PowerPoint Presentation, Tableau Dashboards, Written and Recorded Guides/Tutorials</p>
      <p class="proj-skills"><strong>Technical Skills:</strong> Excel, Tableau, Power Query, Jira, Enterprise Data Restructuring, Workflow Automation</p>
    </a>

    <a class="proj-card" id="proj-ducks" href="projects/ducks/index.html">
      <div class="proj-header">
        <p class="proj-title">Adult Learn-to-Play Analysis</p>
        <p class="proj-meta">UC Irvine &middot; MSBA Capstone (Anaheim Ducks &amp; The Rinks)</p>
        <p class="proj-dates">01/2026-06/2026</p>
      </div>
      <p class="proj-desc">Led SQL and Power BI development for a UCI MSBA Capstone with the Anaheim Ducks and The Rinks, analyzing 1,285 Adult Learn-to-Play participants to determine whether the program drives lasting retention and ticket purchasing, and where engagement could be deepened.</p>
      <p class="proj-skills"><strong>Deliverables:</strong> Written Report, PowerPoint Presentation, Power BI Dashboards</p>
      <p class="proj-skills"><strong>Technical Skills:</strong> SQL, Power BI, Retention Analysis, Marketing Analytics</p>
    </a>

    <a class="proj-card alt" id="proj-lafc" href="projects/lafc/index.html">
      <div class="proj-header">
        <p class="proj-title">LAFC &amp; BMO Stadium: Fan Experience Analysis</p>
        <p class="proj-meta">LAFC Interview Project</p>
        <p class="proj-dates">04/2026</p>
      </div>
      <p class="proj-desc">Analyzed 9,246 fan survey responses across five years of LAFC matches, concerts, and ACFC events using Python-based sentiment analysis, then built a multi-page Tableau dashboard and business plan identifying where LAFC and BMO Stadium should focus to grow revenue and improve the fan experience through 2030.</p>
      <p class="proj-skills"><strong>Deliverables:</strong> PowerPoint Presentation, Tableau Dashboards</p>
      <p class="proj-skills"><strong>Technical Skills:</strong> Python, Tableau, TextBlob, NLP/Sentiment Analysis, Business Strategy</p>
    </a>

    <a class="proj-card" id="proj-uci-bn" href="projects/uci-bn/index.html">
      <div class="proj-header">
        <p class="proj-title">UCI Basic Needs: CalFresh Analysis</p>
        <p class="proj-meta">Independent Project</p>
        <p class="proj-dates">01/2026-03/2026</p>
      </div>
      <p class="proj-desc">Built a multi-page interactive Tableau dashboard on four years of CalFresh appointment data (6,261 records) for UCI's Basic Needs Center, surfacing Enrollment Party growth, no-show patterns, and eligibility trends to identify where program efficiency and student access could improve.</p>
      <p class="proj-skills"><strong>Deliverables:</strong> Tableau Dashboards</p>
      <p class="proj-skills"><strong>Technical Skills:</strong> Excel, Data Cleaning, Tableau, Program Evaluation</p>
    </a>

    <hr class="rule-bold" style="margin-top: 2rem;">

    <a class="proj-card alt" id="proj-sun-country" href="projects/sun-country/index.html">
      <div class="proj-header">
        <p class="proj-title">Sun Country Airlines: Customer Segmentation</p>
        <p class="proj-meta">UC Irvine &middot; MSBA Coursework</p>
        <p class="proj-dates">06/2026-07/2026</p>
      </div>
      <p class="proj-desc">Applied K-Means clustering to 15,144 Sun Country Airlines customer records to identify 5 actionable segments, translating findings into three targeted campaigns tied to Ufly loyalty enrollment, direct channel growth, and vacation package differentiation.</p>
      <p class="proj-skills"><strong>Deliverables:</strong> Report, Slides, Code</p>
      <p class="proj-skills"><strong>Technical Skills:</strong> Python, Elbow Method, EDA, Clustering, Customer Analytics, Segmentation</p>
    </a>

    <a class="proj-card" id="proj-employee-churn" href="projects/employee-churn/index.html">

        <p class="proj-meta">UC Irvine &middot; MSBA Coursework</p>
        <p class="proj-dates">09/2025-12/2025</p>

      <p class="proj-desc">Built and compared logistic regression and decision tree models on 4,653 employee records to identify which employees were most at risk of voluntary turnover, achieving 79% recall on the churn class and surfacing tenure, compensation tier, and education as the primary drivers.</p>
      <p class="proj-skills"><strong>Deliverables:</strong> Report, Slides, Code</p>
      <p class="proj-skills"><strong>Technical Skills:</strong> Python, Cross Validation, Decision Tree, Machine Learning, HR Analytics, Classification</p>
    </a>
